eas_text: A civil authority has issued A MISSING AND ENDANGERED PERSON ALERT for the following counties or areas: Warren, KY; at 9:50 PM on AUG 21, 2025 Effective until 1:50 AM AUG 22, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: At the request of Warren county Sheriff Office an IAN Alert has been issued for Bentley Burton 14 with Autism last seen in Bowling Green Kentucky on August 21st 2025 at approximately 1153 .Bentley Burton is described as a white 5 foot 10in 137lbs male with brown hair and a mustache. Last seen wearing a short sleeve green/tan shirt dark sweat pants and navy tennis shoes.  If seen do not approach. Call 911 or contact Warren County Sheriff office at 270-842-1633 immediately. Stay tuned to local media for more information.
